name: Kiitos!
source:
Summoners attend a school in the Magical 6th District.
This is the adventure of one student, Maru Lou Lourou, 3rd year A class magical girl.

Fantasy Otome Adventure Game. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140914015824/http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_site/1/product_id/RE073743.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
召喚者就讀於魔法第六區的一所學校。
這是三年級魔法少女丸露露露的冒險經歷。

奇幻乙女冒險遊戲。
